goal: Cut GitHub request traffic without slowing work (#2773 part D): an event-aware host-wide watcher wakes each waiter once per change with no request, and its fallback polls through shared conditional reads with x-poll-interval and failure backoff, never busy-looping.
dispatcher: Claude coordinator session relaying Albert's #2773 instruction
prohibited_actions: No database write or structure change of any kind
No weakening of collision locks, migration version reservation or serial lanes
assumptions: Webhook registration on GitHub needs repository settings and is out of scope; the notify hook is the event entry point
stop_conditions: Stop if a wake could be reported without an event or generation change
